title: Credit Minimum for Identification Corrections by Days Since Filing — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — identification corrections (CO-31).** The identification correction's credit minimum follows the calendar days from the claim's filing date to today.

The identification correction's credit minimum is the prompt credit minimum of **2.00 USD** where those days are at most the prompt credit days, **30**; the seasoned credit minimum of **5.00 USD** where they exceed 30 but are at most the seasoned credit days, **120**; and the standard credit minimum of **25.00 USD** where they exceed 120.

Billing-correction credits on the order count toward an identification correction only once their total reaches the credit minimum.

## Worked days (hypothetical claims)

| Filed this many days ago | Band | Credit minimum |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | At most 30 | 2.00 USD |
| 30 | At most 30 | 2.00 USD |
| 31 | Over 30, at most 120 | 5.00 USD |
| 120 | Over 30, at most 120 | 5.00 USD |
| 121 | Over 120 | 25.00 USD |
| 400 | Over 120 | 25.00 USD |

A claim filed 31 days ago with 4.00 USD of billing-correction credits: the minimum is 5.00 USD, so they do not count; at 30 days the minimum would be 2.00 USD and they would.
